goal.en: Make friendly small talk with your neighbor while waiting for the bus.
goal.zh: 等公車時，跟鄰居愉快地閒聊幾句。

background: quiet neighborhood bus stop on a sunny morning, glass shelter with a wooden bench, maple trees with red leaves, wet sidewalk after rain, clear blue sky

intro.en: Monday morning. After a rainy weekend, the sun is finally out.
intro.zh: 星期一早上。下了一整個週末的雨，太陽終於出來了。

intro.en: Mrs. Ellis, your neighbor from downstairs, is already at the bus stop with her green umbrella.
intro.zh: 樓下的鄰居艾利斯太太已經帶著她的綠色雨傘在公車站等車了。

lines.en: Good morning, Kai! Look at all this sunshine!

choices.en: Good morning! Lovely day, isn't it?
choices.tip: Lovely day, isn't it? 是跟鄰居打招呼最安全的開場白。

lines.en: Eaten yet? Oh my. Are you inviting me to breakfast?
lines.zh: 吃了沒？哎呀，你是要約我去吃早餐嗎？

story.en: Mrs. Ellis lets her bus go by. She waits for you to name a restaurant.
story.zh: 艾利斯太太讓公車開走了，她在等你說要去哪家餐廳。

fail.why: 「吃飽沒」是台灣人的打招呼，但英文問 Have you eaten? 會被當成真的在問，甚至以為你要約吃飯。英文打招呼常聊天氣：Lovely day, isn't it?

choices.en: Good morning! It's very sun today.

lines.en: Very sun? Oh, you mean very sunny, dear!
lines.zh: 很太陽？喔，你是說很晴朗吧！

story.en: Mrs. Ellis teaches you sunny, rainy, windy, and cloudy until the bus arrives. You get a gold star.
story.zh: 艾利斯太太一路教你 sunny、rainy、windy、cloudy，直到公車來。你還得到一顆金星星。

fail.why: sun 是名詞「太陽」，描述天氣要用形容詞 sunny：It's sunny today.。同理 rain 變 rainy，cloud 變 cloudy。

lines.en: It certainly is! I was getting so tired of the rain.
lines.zh: 真的是！我都快被雨煩死了。

choices.en: Me too. It rained all weekend, didn't it?
choices.zh: 我也是。整個週末都在下雨，對吧？
choices.tip: 句尾加 didn't it? 這種附加問句，可以邀請對方繼續聊。

choices.en: Me too. It rain all weekend, right?
choices.zh: 我也是。整個週末都在下雨，對吧？

lines.en: It rains all weekend? Oh no, is more rain coming?
lines.zh: 整個週末都會下雨？天啊，又要下雨了嗎？

story.en: Mrs. Ellis hurries home to get her raincoat. She misses her bus.
story.zh: 艾利斯太太急忙回家拿雨衣，結果錯過了公車。

fail.why: 下雨是上個週末的事，要用過去式 It rained。少了 -ed，聽起來像在預報接下來的天氣。

choices.en: Yeah. I hate rain. Maple Bay weather is terrible.
choices.zh: 對啊，我討厭下雨。楓灣的天氣很爛。

lines.en: Terrible? Well, I've lived here forty years. I rather like it.
lines.zh: 很爛？這個嘛，我在這裡住了四十年，我還挺喜歡的。

title.en: Cloudy with a Chance of Awkward

story.en: Mrs. Ellis reads her newspaper until the bus comes. The sun is out, but the air feels chilly.
story.zh: 艾利斯太太一直看報紙到公車來。太陽明明出來了，空氣卻有點冷。

fail.why: 跟在地人聊天氣可以小抱怨，但說 terrible 等於批評對方住了一輩子的地方。輕鬆附和就好：It rained all weekend, didn't it?

lines.en: It really did. So, how's school going?
lines.zh: 真的。那，學校的生活還好嗎？

choices.en: Pretty good, thanks. My classes are fun.
choices.zh: 還不錯，謝謝。我的課都很有趣。
choices.tip: 回答 How's...going? 用 Pretty good. 再補一句細節，對話就不會冷掉。

choices.en: It's that way. Twenty minutes by bus.
choices.zh: 在那邊，坐公車二十分鐘。

lines.en: I know where it is, dear. I meant, how are your classes?
lines.zh: 我知道學校在哪啦。我是問你上課還好嗎？

story.en: Mrs. Ellis thanks you for the directions and tells you how to get to the post office, too.
story.zh: 艾利斯太太謝謝你指路，還順便告訴你郵局怎麼走。

fail.why: How's school going? 問的是你的學校生活過得如何，不是問學校在哪裡。回答感受就好：Pretty good, thanks.。

choices.en: Not bad. How much rent do you pay?

lines.en: My rent? My, that's rather a personal question.
lines.zh: 我的房租？哎呀，這問題有點私人呢。

story.en: Mrs. Ellis suddenly gets very interested in the bus schedule. She checks it five times.
story.zh: 艾利斯太太突然對公車時刻表非常有興趣，看了五遍。

fail.why: 在台灣聊房租很平常，但英語文化裡錢的話題（房租、薪水、價格）都很私人。跟鄰居閒聊停在天氣、學校、週末計畫就好。

lines.en: Oh, here's my bus. It was nice chatting with you, Kai!
lines.zh: 喔，我的公車來了。跟你聊天很開心，凱！

choices.en: You too! Have a lovely day.
choices.zh: 我也是！祝你有美好的一天。
choices.tip: 對方說 nice chatting with you，回 You too! 再加一句祝福，道別就很溫暖。

lines.en: Walk slowly? Oh dear, do I look that old?
lines.zh: 慢慢走？哎呀，我看起來有那麼老嗎？

story.en: Mrs. Ellis climbs onto the bus very, very slowly, just for you. The driver is not amused.
story.zh: 為了你，艾利斯太太非常、非常慢地走上公車。司機一點也不覺得好笑。

fail.why: 「慢走」是中文送客的客套話，直翻成 Walk slowly 像在提醒對方走路小心，甚至暗示對方老了。道別說 Have a lovely day! 或 Take care!。

choices.en: OK, bye. I'm waiting for another bus.

story.en: Mrs. Ellis waves from the bus window, but only a tiny wave.
story.zh: 艾利斯太太從車窗跟你揮手，但只揮了一下下。

fail.why: 對方說 It was nice chatting with you. 是在釋出善意，只回 OK, bye. 很冷淡。先回 You too!，再加一句祝福。

lines.en: What a sweet neighbor! Come by for tea this weekend, Kai. I'll bake a lemon cake.
lines.zh: 真是個貼心的鄰居！這週末來喝茶吧，凱，我來烤檸檬蛋糕。

lines.en: The bus pulls away. Mrs. Ellis waves at you from the window.
lines.zh: 公車開走了，艾利斯太太在窗邊對你揮手。

story.en: A few words about the weather turned into an invitation for tea and homemade cake.
story.zh: 幾句關於天氣的閒聊，換來一場下午茶和手作蛋糕的邀約。

notes.explain: 英語圈最安全的開場白就是聊天氣，不會冒犯人，也很容易接話。
前面是肯定句，後面就用否定的附加問句，時態跟著前面走。It rained 是過去式，所以接 didn't it?。

notes.zh: 晴朗的／下雨的／颳風的／多雲的
notes.explain: 天氣名詞加 -y 就變形容詞，用來描述天氣：It's sunny.。注意 sun 要多一個 n 變 sunny。

example.en: It was windy and cloudy yesterday.

notes.explain: 跟鄰居或不熟的人閒聊，聊天氣、週末、學校最安全。房租、薪水、年齡這些話題在英語文化裡太私人。

notes.zh: 祝你有美好的一天（不是「慢走」）。
notes.explain: 「慢走」直翻成 Walk slowly 會讓人誤會。道別時說 Have a lovely day!、Take care! 或 See you later! 就很自然。
